audit_metadata.title: Complete Solar Filament Model Forensic Experiment Audit
audit_metadata.audit_type: READ-ONLY FORENSIC AUDIT — NO MODEL OR PROJECT FILES WERE MODIFIED
audit_metadata.disclaimer: Audit generated from the current workspace state. Previous conversational instructions and generated summaries were not treated as proof of experiment completion.

source_directories.purpose: Training loops, loss definitions (Dice, BCE, Focal, Boundary), metrics
Dataset loader, solar disk detection, limb darkening, CLAHE, caching
Classical differential geometry (Frangi vesselness, Hessian ridges, morphology)
Late fusion of Deep Learning and Classical predictions
Filament structural scoring (0-100), multi-filament bounding box cropping
Multi-band solar colormaps (H-alpha Gold, AIA 304/171, Inferno)
Ablation experiments, parameter studies, curve plotting scripts
Visualizations, training curves, error analyses, ablation artifacts

part_2_dataset_audit.source_telescope: Global Oscillation Network Group (GONG) & BBSO Full-Disk H-alpha Solar Network
part_2_dataset_audit.class_mapping: Binary segmentation (0 = Quiet Sun Background, 1 = Solar Filament)
part_2_dataset_audit.train_val_split: 80% Train (565 images) / 20% Val (142 images) partitioned with strict Seed 42

impact_analysis.training_loss: AFFECTED — Model is penalized when GT filaments exist in the blackened 7% annulus.
